remarks: Welcome to 145 Weed Street, a meticulously maintained Colonial offering a flexible floor plan, four finished levels and a convenient location just minutes from the heart of New Canaan. Built in 1995, this 4-bedroom, 3-bath home combines spacious, light-filled living with the benefits of newer construction and thoughtfully updated mechanical systems. The dramatic living room features soaring ceilings and an abundance of natural light, creating a bright and inviting space. The kitchen offers recently upgraded stainless steel appliances, a propane range and generous cabinet storage, with direct access to a large deck ideal for dining al fresco and entertaining. The deck overlooks the fully fenced backyard, providing a private and versatile outdoor setting. Four finished levels allow the home to adapt easily to a variety of needs, including a finished lower-level recreation room. Originally designed with a three-car garage, One of the three garage bays is currently used as a mudroom and storage area, with the original garage door track and opener still in place, adding everyday convenience while retaining two garage bays. Pride of ownership is evident throughout, with significant recent improvements including a new boiler and electrical panel in 2023, two new HVAC condensers in 2022 and a repaved driveway in 2024. With its 1995 construction, refreshed major systems and south-of-town location offering convenient access for commuters while remaining just minutes from downtown NC.
